description: Source code for AAudioBinderAdapter class implementing audio stream control via Android binder interface.

classes.name: AAudioBinderAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for controlling audio streams via Android binder interface.

methods.name: AAudioBinderAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing delegate and service lifetime ID.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client with the delegate.

methods.name: openStream
methods.description: Opens an audio stream with specified request and config.

methods.name: closeStream
methods.description: Closes an audio stream identified by handle info.

methods.name: registerAudioThread
methods.description: Registers an audio thread for the stream.

methods.name: unregisterAudioThread
methods.description: Unregisters an audio thread from the stream.

methods.name: exitStandby
methods.description: Exits standby mode for the stream and retrieves endpoint info.
